issues.where: the car card's header, left of the plate
issues.what: The plate 12-345-67 sits at the right edge with a chevron to its left; the left part of the card header looks fine, but the top-right add button and title are fine too. No clear defect here.

issues.where: the bottom navigation bar, the notification bell icon
issues.what: The red badge with the number 1 sits on the bell icon's corner; this is an allowed notification badge, so not a defect.

issues.where: the background segmented control under 'רקע', its left option

issues.where: the table header row at the left edge of the car card, the last column
issues.what: The last column header wraps and is clipped at the card's left edge, so it reads as "טיפ" over "אחו" and the word טיפול is not fully visible.

issues.where: table header row of the car card, last column at the left edge
issues.what: The last column header is split over two lines and reads "טיפ" / "אחו". It looks like a longer word (probably טיפול / אחזקה) is cut and its remaining letters are missing, so the column title cannot be read in full.

issues.where: top of the car card, above the divider line and the table header
issues.what: A large empty white area sits at the top of the card, above the line and the table header, where a title or content would be expected.

issues.where: second card on the home screen, title area
issues.text: יש לכם כבר רכב? פתחו לו תיק
issues.what: At 130% font size the title wraps so that the single word "תיק" sits alone on the second line, leaving an awkward gap and an uneven title block next to the blue icon.

issues.where: the plate input row, the left-most blue search button
issues.what: The blue search button is not aligned with the plate input's height and top; it sits a bit lower and extends beyond the input box, which looks misaligned. Low confidence this is a real defect.

issues.where: the footer line at the bottom above the bottom navigation bar
issues.text: המידע מגיע מהמאגרים הפתוחים של משרד התחבורה ב-data.gov.il, ואינו מחליף
issues.what: The footer sentence is cut off at the right side near the screen edge: the text appears to start at the right margin with little padding, and the sentence ends abruptly at 'ואינו מחליף' with the rest missing, reading as a truncated sentence at the left edge.

issues.where: the plate input in the header, the example/placeholder area
issues.what: The plate input shows a value 76-543-21 with the country strip IL ישראל; this is fine. No defect here.

issues.where: the plate input's left blue Israel strip and the IL label
issues.what: The plate input shows the Israeli strip with 'IL' and 'ישראל' stacked; this is a design choice, not a defect. No issue here.

issues.where: the plate input field, right side of the yellow plate
issues.what: The typed plate number is drawn in a dim olive/yellow-grey on the yellow plate, so it reads as low contrast against the yellow background, though still visible.

issues.where: inside the table card, between the card's top edge and the table column headers
issues.what: There is an empty band of about 60px at the top of the card above the column headers (רכב, טסט, ריקול, טיפול אחרון), with no visible content, so the card looks like it is missing a title or summary row.

issues.where: the empty-state card, body paragraph
issues.text: מוסיפים רכב לפי מספר הרישוי שלו, או בכוכב שבראש הדוח של רכב שבודקים. מכאן נתריע על ריקול חדש ועל טסט שמתקרב, ואפשר להשוות בין הרכבים.
issues.what: The sentence says 'או בכוכב' (or with the star) which is a grammatically awkward phrasing, and 'שבודקים' after 'רכב' reads oddly; the wording appears off, but this is a low-confidence wording issue rather than a clear typo.

issues.where: the period chips under 'בחירת תקופה' in the first card
issues.what: The 2022 year chip sits alone on a second line, right-aligned under the 2026 chip, while 2023 to 2026 share the first line. It looks like a control dropped onto its own line rather than part of the row.

issues.where: top action bar, below the star and share icons
issues.what: The 'שיתוף' (share) label sits under the star and share icons and is offset to the left of the share icon, so it reads as a label for the star-and-share group rather than for the share icon alone. Low-confidence layout blemish.

issues.where: the car card's bottom row, right side
issues.what: At 200% font the test label wraps so that "חודשים" sits alone on its own line below "טסט בעוד 13", which looks like an awkward break next to the date on the left.

issues.where: the subtitle line under the page title
issues.text: רכב אחד ● אחד צריך תשומת לב
issues.what: The subtitle reads oddly: 'רכב אחד' followed by a red dot and 'אחד צריך תשומת לב' is a grammatically awkward, mixed count phrase; the red dot sits between two counts, which reads as a bullet rather than a clear sentence.

issues.where: the filter chips row above the car card
issues.what: The chip label is partly misaligned: its count '1' is placed at the far left end while the label sits to the right, so the chip reads with uneven internal spacing compared with the 'הכול 1' chip.

issues.where: the background segmented control, leftmost segment
issues.what: The label 'לפי המכשיר' runs almost to the left edge of the segmented control's dark track and may be clipped at its left end at 130% font size. It looks tight, so it may be clipped at the edge.

issues.where: the second card in the list, the description text under the title
issues.what: The description paragraph in the second alert card is a little tight against the title above it, but otherwise readable; no clear defect visible.

issues.where: the table header row of the car list card, at the left edge of the card

issues.where: the top of the car list card, above the table header

issues.where: table header row of the car list card, last column at the left edge

issues.where: top of the white car list card, above the divider line

issues.where: the background segmented control in the settings card, first option at the left edge of the control
issues.what: At 130% font size the option label 'לפי המכשיר' runs almost to the left edge of its segment container, so its last letters may be clipped or touching the border. Low confidence, because the text appears fully visible.

issues.text: יש לכם כבר רכב? פתחו לו תיק
